value.rationale: Nilpotency degree exactly three is the first structurally nonnull stratum excluded by the earlier sharp null maximizers. Its size and embedding classification were not supplied by the broader literature. The exact census up to the natural seven-point cutoff gives complete maxima and every orbit type, including a genuine two-orbit transition at six and single orbit at seven; this distinguishes constrained semigroup structure rather than providing an arbitrary sampled count. It supplies benchmark constraints and candidate patterns for any subsequent all-degree theorem, without claiming the latter.
